name: io.github.OrygnsCode/discord-mcp
title: Discord MCP
description: Discord server management MCP for AI agents: chat, moderation, admin, and full server building.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. The init wizard sets this up.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_GUILD
environmentVariables.description: Optional default server id so tools can omit the guild parameter.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. true loads only the tools that change nothing.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_ALLOWED_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Server ids, separated by commas, that the tools may act in.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Anonymous daily usage stats, on by default. off turns them off.
